ops.title: mid-2026 iMessage-bridge landscape — rustpush is now full-featured protocol-direct (no SIP), but library-only; the VM-unification decision
ops.body:
Adversarially-verified research (2026-07-07) for the "retire the bluebubbles VM" decision. Supersedes the old plan's premise that "no-SIP + full features + BlueBubbles-REST" were mutually exclusive.

- **BlueBubbles Private API is SIP-off forever.** It's DYLD dylib injection into Messages.app; no SIP-on path exists or is on any roadmap. macOS 26 Tahoe made it *worse*: now needs SIP-off + AMFI boot-args + library-validation-off + a re-signed patched helper. Last official release v1.9.9 predates Tahoe; issues #755/#761/#776/#777 all open. So co-locating BlueBubbles on SIP-on metal is impossible — this kills the old "Option 1 (Private-API-off on metal)" too, since the user wants to KEEP the private features.
- **rustpush (OpenBubbles) now has the full feature set protocol-direct** — typing, read/delivered receipts, reply threading (`reply_guid`/`reply_part`), reactions, edit/unsend, groups, attachments — NO SIP, NO Mac at runtime (`src/imessage/messages.rs`). But it's a **Rust library, SSPL-v1** (exception OpenBubbles-only), no REST server. `jesec/imessage-rs` is the only BB-REST server but still needs SIP-off injection; `lrhodin/imessage` ("Corten", v1.0.6) is a headless rustpush bridge but speaks **Matrix**, not BB-REST.
- **Decision (user picked): Variant F** — build `imsg-bridge`, a headless Rust daemon on metal embedding rustpush + serving the BB-REST surface hermes already speaks (hermes untouched). metal stays SIP-on (a daemon needs no GUI/SIP change; metal is headless anyway). See the plan: acct-09/plans/revisit-users-yasyf-cc-pool-accounts-acc-dapper-taco.md.
- **The sharp gate — Apple identity/NAC.** Two blobs (hardware-identity profile + NAC validation-data) must BOTH derive from the **physical host** (genuine hardware), never the metal guest's `VirtualMac2,1` identity. **Native `AAAbsintheContext` NAC on the guest keys off the VM identity → ban vector.** Safe paths: software-NAC-on-metal fed host codes (ClearADI closed-source since Jan 2026 → blob dep), or a host-side native-NAC oracle. Register with an Apple ID (auto device-free renewal; one-time 2FA). Hardware-identity binding is shared-fate with the host. Ban recovery needs a human Apple-support call (rare for a low-volume reactive reply bot).
- The hermes BB adapter's real used surface is 14 REST endpoints + 1 webhook, single password query-param; only 3 private features are actually used (typing, read receipts, reply threading) — **tapback SEND is not implemented upstream** (empty stub; inbound tapbacks only detected+skipped); cold new-chat is not needed.

Relates to [[bluebubbles-server-bringup-2026-07]] (the SIP-off VM being retired) and [[macos-guest-vm-ops]].
